name: Remove Program Members
summary: Deletes program member records for the listed leads (up to 300 per call) — i.e. removes them from the program. The lead records themselves are untouched.
whenToUse: When people should no longer be in the program at all (different from just changing their status).
confirm: Remove the listed leads from this program (their membership record is deleted — the lead records themselves are NOT). Continue?

body.hint: Lead IDs to remove from the program — comma-separated.

response.description: Per lead: deleted or skipped (e.g. 'Lead not in program').

notes: This is the API equivalent of taking someone out of the program entirely — their program member fields come with the deleted record.
